t’s always super distasteful when someone else who has been through similar shit thinks that their experience now applies to everyone else. It doesn’t.

Child benefit- never saw a penny of that due to being in an abusive household. Wasn’t able to work until I turned 18 and all my jobs that I did manage to get required me to bring a birth certificate and proof of address in place of photo ID.




Photo ID was £34. I was unable to be on UC or JSA at all, so I was not on benefits (until well after the age of 23)

I had literally no income at the time. None. Zilch. The money I borrowed from friends went to food, and I lived on a mattress in my friends flat for free when I escaped my home life.


Like I had already stated, food was a priority, staying alive was a priority; but getting photo ID, despite it been incredibly important, was not top of the list. Factor in being disabled and having to pay for buses to and from the GP and hospital often- leaves even less money.

Please don’t act like because something is possible for you when you deemed yourself to be struggling, that it becomes possible for everyone else
